name: infra_compile_amp
title: torch.compile + channels_last + bf16 autocast + activation checkpointing + EMA
origin: hardening round 1, tester domain-infra: the modern single-GPU mechanics stack
note: A pure precision trap: the program is correct and MLView reports nothing on it. The two traps that matter are (a) bf16 autocast with no GradScaler - correct, because bf16 carries fp32's exponent range - and (b) an EMA update that mutates a shadow copy in place under @torch.no_grad().

forbidden.why: the training loader is built with shuffle=True at line 93
the validation loader is built with shuffle=False at line 96
num_workers defaults to 8 but the module ends in `if __name__ == "__main__": main()` and the loaders are built inside main()
optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True) is called at line 154, before the autocast forward
the order is zero_grad (154) -> autocast forward (155-157) -> backward (158) -> clip (159) -> step (160) -> scheduler (161)
nothing accumulates a live loss tensor: the training loop keeps no running total and validate() accumulates loss.item() under no_grad
OneCycleLR is a per-batch schedule and scheduler.step() is called inside the batch loop at line 161, which is the correct cadence for it
there is no GradScaler in this file and there must not be: autocast runs in bfloat16 (line 133), which has fp32's exponent range, so loss scaling is unnecessary and torch documents it as such
clip_grad_norm_ at line 159 sits between backward() (158) and optimizer.step() (160), which is the only correct position
validate() calls model.eval() at line 102 and restores model.train() at line 116; the EMA shadow module is constructed already in eval() at line 68
the validation loop is inside `with torch.no_grad():` at line 105 and ModelEMA.update carries @torch.no_grad() at line 70
every batch is moved with .to(device, memory_format=torch.channels_last, non_blocking=True) on both paths, and the model is moved at line 135
the device is chosen behind torch.cuda.is_available() at line 132
seed_everything(args.seed) at line 130 calls random.seed, numpy.random.seed, torch.manual_seed and torch.cuda.manual_seed_all
Block.__init__ (line 29) and ConvNet.__init__ (line 44) both call super().__init__() first; ModelEMA is not an nn.Module
the six blocks are held in nn.ModuleList at line 47
the checkpoint is a dict of state_dicts (line 170), not the module object, and this file never calls torch.load
